biotools.summary: ProteinMCP is an agentic AI framework designed to automate and accelerate the entire workflow of computational protein engineering. It orchestrates a unified ecosystem of specialized tools via a Model-Context-Protocol (MCP) to deliver high-efficiency, end-to-end protein design.
biotools.name: ProteinMCP: Agentic AI Framework for Protein Engineering
